# Impacgo Solutions

> Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations and Power Platform implementation partner for global enterprises, based in Visakhapatnam, India, with deep India compliance expertise (GST, e-invoicing). Impacgo also builds its own software products.

- [Dynamics 365 F&O Implementation](https://www.impacgo.com/services/d365)

- [D365FO Development & Customisation](https://www.impacgo.com/services/d365-development)
- [Dynamics 365 CRM](https://www.impacgo.com/services/d365-crm) — Sales, Customer Service, Marketing, Field Service

## Our own products

- [CALVIQ](https://www.impacgo.com/products/dairy-farm) — dairy farm management system (milk production, herd health, breeding, feed, finance)
- [StockLyte](https://www.impacgo.com/products/inventory-management) — real-time, multi-location inventory management
- [FarmYieldIQ](https://www.impacgo.com/products/farm-yield-iq) — farmland plot operations platform
- [Work Task Application](https://www.impacgo.com/products/work-task) — consultant/employee time tracking
- [Construction Planner](https://www.impacgo.com/products/construction-planner) — AI-powered construction planning (in development)

## Impacgo ERP Suite

Our own in-house business platform, built as one connected system. Impacgo HRMS, Finance, Chain, Make and Retail are available today — book a free demo at https://www.impacgo.com/erp-suite/demo.

- [Impacgo ERP — overview](https://www.impacgo.com/erp-suite) — the full ERP suite site
- [Book a free Impacgo ERP demo](https://www.impacgo.com/erp-suite/demo)
- [Impacgo HRMS](https://www.impacgo.com/erp-suite#module-hrms) — workforce management
- [Impacgo Finance](https://www.impacgo.com/erp-suite#module-finance) — accounting & compliance across legal entities
- [Impacgo Chain](https://www.impacgo.com/erp-suite#module-chain) — supply chain management (CRM to logistics)
- [Impacgo Make](https://www.impacgo.com/erp-suite#module-make) — manufacturing
- [Impacgo Plan](https://www.impacgo.com/erp-suite#module-plan) — planning & MRP
- [Impacgo Retail](https://www.impacgo.com/erp-suite#module-retail) — POS & store operations
- [Impacgo Project](https://www.impacgo.com/erp-suite#module-project) — project & delivery management
